_comment: Quest chain, decided by the authority (SimAuthority quest_event). Types: talk (target = NPC name, within talk_radius of that NPC), kill (target = mob species from its scene, mob_<species>.tscn), monolith, refine (a successful wand refinement), visit (target = a place below; `mounted` requires the broom). Rewards: reward_exp, reward_gold, reward_house_rep. Progress persists in the character's `quests` object (active, progress, done).

chain.title: First-Year Orientation
chain.name: Speak with Professor Fig in the courtyard
chain.desc: Find Professor Fig near the fountain (gold ! marker).

chain.title: Acromantula Infestation
chain.name: Defeat 4 Acromantulas
chain.desc: Giant spiders nest west of the castle. Thin them out.

chain.title: Restless Inferi
chain.name: Defeat 4 Inferi
chain.desc: Inferi stalk the forest edge. Burn them - fire hurts them double.

chain.title: Shatter the Darkness
chain.name: Help destroy 1 Dark Monolith
chain.desc: Join others at a Dark Monolith (purple beam) and break it.

chain.title: Ollivander's Favor
chain.name: Refine your wand to +2
chain.desc: Visit Ollivander's Forge (press O) and refine twice.

chain.title: Quidditch Tryouts
chain.name: Mount your broom and visit the Quidditch Pitch
chain.desc: Press Shift to mount, then fly to the golden hoops east.
